gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-arvo: Arvo has a dignified, old-fashioned manner, with curves that stop short of closing up. Arvo carries a text serif's gravity under Bellota Text, whose rounded wire strokes look like nothing else on the page.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-belgrano: Belgrano brings a traditional, classic serif feel, its open-mouthed curves staying clear and legible. Belgrano would look lost if the heading shrank, since Bellota Text, with its round, unshaded outline, needs size to earn its commanding presence.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-biorhyme: Refined and bookish, BioRhyme ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, with capitals spaced wide apart. Bellota Text above it keeps every letter at uninterrupted line width, a wiry, display-minded counterpart.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-biorhyme-expanded: Bellota Text opens with commanding, distinctive letters whose crossbars are as heavy as their stems, with no shading anywhere. BioRhyme Expanded, a text serif, feels bookish and refined beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-biz-udmincho: Wiry and wide-eyed, Bellota Text draws every stroke at one thickness, leaving BIZ UDMincho's shallow terminal curl and wide gaps to supply the bookish, traditional side. Together it's a classic serif against a display voice, and the difference is the point.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-copse: Strokes drawn like a stylus held at fixed pressure define Bellota Text here. Copse answers in a literary serif voice with daylight showing through every curve, and that gap between wire-like display and classic reading type is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cutive: Refined, almost typewritten, Cutive spreads its serif letters wide. Bellota Text brings a pipe-cleaner strand to the heading, and a slightly larger body size would let Cutive's generous c openings breathe.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-david-libre: Dignified and refined, David Libre leaves its serif terminals hanging open beneath a heading traced in one thickness. A touch more size on David Libre would help it hold its own against Bellota Text's commanding strokes.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-enriqueta: Literary and dignified, Enriqueta draws chalky curves that stop well before closing, a text serif with real character. And Bellota Text, with curves as hefty as a rope's body, makes the strongest possible foil.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-fenix: Bellota Text is a steady line with no pressure variation, wiry and commanding in display. Fenix follows with classic, editorial text serif curves that end before turning inward, which keeps a long page feeling open.
